hubble.description: Hubble cloud credentials discover your owned cameras and enable native Orbweb LAN video without Android. Omitted 3667 cameras are recovered automatically from the account subscription inventory. Manual camera identifiers and the local list remain optional fallbacks. You can link a local IP address to each 3667 in the next step.
